headlines: Telecoms still sharply lower: T -10%, VZ -9%, TMUS -12.6% on heavy volume

rumors.text: Telecom selloff (T, VZ, TMUS) tied to SpaceX (SPCX) direct-to-cell ambitions; unconfirmed, same story as earlier
rumors.why: If SpaceX competes as a carrier, incumbents lose pricing power and subscribers

rumors.text: Chatter about US business with Russia over diesel (Russian diesel imports) amid a diesel supply squeeze
rumors.why: Easing fuel supply stress would relieve an inflation and energy risk for the broad market

rumors.text: Expected late-day drop or bleed into the close around 3:50pm after expiration pin
rumors.why: A weekend-risk de-risking would pull SPY off its highs into the bell

plays.reason: Steady drift higher, VIX under 15, broad gains in QQQ and IWM; crowd bullish but split with bears calling a late drop

readings.whats_new: SPY ticked up to 778.47 (+0.59%) with VIX flat near 14.9 and fear and greed about 45. Telecom losses persist (SpaceX link still unconfirmed) and PLTR is pushing record highs. New chatter is about Russian diesel and a late-day drop call; earlier pin and thin-volume talk faded.
